aps.package_tree_rule: sha256 over, for every file of the installed package in sorted path order, its path relative to the package root, a newline, the sha256 hex of its bytes and a newline
aps.source_notes: the tag v8.0.1 resolves to this commit, and the package.json in the npm tarball is byte for byte the one at this commit (sha256 7ba3940946bca27fb824760ff124843bd69daccc42cbde0f3a3db7858b07cbf6). The dist files were not rebuilt from source here; the files below are the sources of the functions this adapter calls, at this commit, for a reader who wants to compare them.

pic.notes: the adapter does not run PIC. It recomputes args_digest (sha256 of PIC canonical JSON of the arguments), claims_digest (of the claims array) and intent_digest (of the raw UTF-8 intent) with its own RFC 8785 writer, held to the refund-approval example at pic-standard 74f980c6625098237a8d5d3333a0249a1fb47a25 by the selftest vectors.
